response.text: I have enough for a solid picture. Let me check the memos and the one unbalanced journal, since memo text is untrusted and should be reported, not acted on.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", LEFT(h."MEMO", 120) AS memo_excerpt FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT") <> SUM("CR_AMT")) OR h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", LEFT(h."MEMO", 120) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 3);
